title.en: Deposit USDC into a Morpho vault through VaultBundlesV1
title.zh-TW: 經由 VaultBundlesV1 把 USDC 存進 Morpho vault

summary.en: Approves exactly the amount of the vault's asset to Morpho's VaultBundlesV1, which pulls it and deposits it into the vault for your Safe, reverting if the share price is above the bound the card's fewest shares give. Refuses a referral fee, a permit, an approval larger than the amount, and a deadline more than 2 hours ahead.
summary.zh-TW: 把剛好等於金額的 vault 資產授權給 Morpho 的 VaultBundlesV1，由它拉走並替你的 Safe 存進 vault；份額價格高於卡片最少份額換算的上限就 revert。拒絕推薦費、permit、超過金額的授權，以及超過 2 小時後的期限。

intro.en: Morpho Vault V2 is an ERC-4626 vault: you deposit an asset and get shares. A curator chooses where the vault lends through adapters and caps; Morpho's bundles are fixed entry points its app calls to deposit with a price bound.
intro.zh-TW: Morpho Vault V2 是 ERC-4626 vault：存入資產、拿到份額。curator 透過轉接合約和上限決定 vault 借給哪裡；Morpho 的 bundles 是 app 呼叫的固定入口，存款時帶價格上限。

text.en: Vault V2's GitHub lists 18 audit reports, among them Spearbit, Zellic, Blackthorn, ChainSecurity, Certora and a contest, and three of the MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2 (Blackthorn, Certora, Spearbit) dated 2025-12-04. The bundles repository lists a Blackthorn audit of the Blue and vault bundles dated 2026-08-07. DefiLlama lists no hack of Morpho Blue. Steakhouse reports that its vault users took no bad debt in the 2026 drawdowns, a claim from the curator itself.
text.zh-TW: Vault V2 的 GitHub 列了 18 份稽核報告，包括 Spearbit、Zellic、Blackthorn、ChainSecurity、Certora 和一場競賽，其中 MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2 有三份（Blackthorn、Certora、Spearbit，2025-12-04）。bundles repo 列有 Blackthorn 對 Blue 與 vault bundles 的稽核（2026-08-07）。DefiLlama 沒有列出 Morpho Blue 的駭客事件。Steakhouse 說 2026 年的下跌中它的 vault 使用者沒有承擔壞帳，這是 curator 自己的說法。

1.approve.spender.en: VaultBundlesV1, the only contract allowed to pull the USDC. It pulls from the caller alone, the Safe, and spends the whole amount in the same transaction.
1.approve.spender.zh-TW: VaultBundlesV1，唯一能拉走 USDC 的合約。它只從呼叫者（Safe）拉，並在同一筆交易用完整個金額。

1.approve.value.en: Exactly the deposit amount, so no allowance is left open after the deposit.
1.approve.value.zh-TW: 剛好等於存款金額，存完後不留任何授權。

2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.vault.en: The vault to deposit into; the bundle reads its asset from it and mints the shares to the caller, the Safe.
2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.vault.zh-TW: 要存入的 vault；bundle 從它讀資產，並把份額鑄給呼叫者，也就是 Safe。

2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.assets.en: The amount of USDC pulled from the Safe; with no referral fee all of it is deposited.
2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.assets.zh-TW: 從 Safe 拉走的 USDC 數量；沒有推薦費時全部存入。

2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.maxSharePriceE27.en: The most assets per share, scaled by 1e27, the deposit may pay; the bundle reverts above it, so you get at least the card's fewest shares.
2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.maxSharePriceE27.zh-TW: 每份額最多付多少資產（乘 1e27）；超過時 bundle 會 revert，所以你至少拿到卡片上的最少份額。

2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.assetPermit.en: A signed permit the bundle could use instead of the approval; the template allows none.
2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.assetPermit.zh-TW: bundle 可用來代替授權的簽名 permit；模板不允許。

2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.assetPermit.kind.en: 0 means no permit: the bundle pulls with the plain approval of call 1.
2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.assetPermit.kind.zh-TW: 0 代表不用 permit：bundle 用第 1 個呼叫的一般授權拉款。

2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.assetPermit.data.en: Empty, since a permit of kind 0 carries no data and the bundle does not read it.
2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.assetPermit.data.zh-TW: 空的，因為種類 0 的 permit 不帶資料，bundle 也不讀。

2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.referralFeePct.en: 0: no share of the deposit is paid away as a referral fee.
2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.referralFeePct.zh-TW: 0：存款不會被抽一部分當推薦費。

2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.referralFeeRecip.en: The zero address, since no fee is paid.
2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.referralFeeRecip.zh-TW: 零地址，因為不付推薦費。

2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.deadline.en: After this time the bundle reverts. Morpho's SDK sets bundle deadlines two hours ahead by default, so the template allows at most 7,200 seconds after the block; the share price bound holds either way.
2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.deadline.zh-TW: 超過這個時間 bundle 會 revert。Morpho SDK 預設把 bundle 期限設在兩小時後，所以模板最多允許區塊時間後 7,200 秒；份額價格上限一樣有效。

text.en: The Morpho app reaches this vault by two routes: Bundler3 multicall until block 26046109, and VaultBundlesV1 since block 26050001. The template covers VaultBundlesV1, which Morpho's docs name and mark Bundler3 deprecated.
text.zh-TW: Morpho app 走過兩條路線：區塊 26046109 以前是 Bundler3 multicall，26050001 以後是 VaultBundlesV1。模板涵蓋 VaultBundlesV1，Morpho 文件已標 Bundler3 為 deprecated。

recommendation.en: A deposit sent through Bundler3 or another route gets MISMATCH; ask for that route's template then.
recommendation.zh-TW: 經由 Bundler3 或其他路線的存款會 MISMATCH；遇到時再要求該路線的模板。

pastTxsConclusion.en: Most misfits are the older Bundler3 route; others are deposits with an allowance already open or larger than the amount, which the template refuses on purpose.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 多數不符的是舊的 Bundler3 路線；其他是已經有授權、或授權大於金額的存款，模板刻意拒絕。
